candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes an irregular narrow complex tachycardia with an atrial rate of 210 bpm, which is consistent with atrial fibrillation. The reference diagnosis of Advanced interatrial block (IAB) with Bayés syndrome is the underlying cause of the atrial fibrillation in this context. Therefore, atrial fibrillation is a manifestation of the reference diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Atrial fibrillation is a manifestation of Bayés syndrome, which is caused by advanced interatrial block.
